title: TRUECUT Works
description: Field engineering, shown clearly. An image-led conversion page with a survey-line field log, proof reels, and one site-visit action.
stack: Next.js 16 · Tailwind v4 · Local Form State · CSS Motion · Media Placeholders

sections.title: Hero / site walk
sections.summary: full-bleed `hero-site-reel.mp4` with `hero-site-walk` poster, headline “See the work. Book the next step.”, one primary CTA, one proof link, and three numbered field-log cues.

sections.title: Capabilities
sections.summary: four image cards (`capability-testing`, `capability-controls`, `capability-retrofit`, `capability-design`). Selecting a card marks the scope and syncs the booking form’s service radio.

sections.title: Field reel
sections.summary: pinned stage with `process-proof.mp4`, three measured notes (site, proof, handoff), and a survey marker that updates as notes enter the viewport.
sections.customCodeReason: Contains interactive 3D/WebGL, procedural canvas, or pinned scroll-scrubbed stage requiring an HtmlEmbed + page footer script.

sections.title: Projects
sections.summary: three full-bleed proof cards (`project-switchyard`, `project-control-room`, `project-panel-detail`) with project IDs and handoff notes.

sections.title: Working method
sections.summary: dark section with `safety-hands` and `handoff-drawing`, plus three steps: read the site, make the proof, leave the handoff.

sections.title: Booking
sections.summary: `credential-grid` and panel detail images beside a local form for name, work email, and service. Submit transitions idle → loading → success and replaces the form with a ticket containing `SITE VISIT REQUESTED` and a stable code.

customCodeBlocks.title: TRUECUT Works Scoped Styles
customCodeBlocks.description: Authored custom CSS variables, pseudo-elements, and keyframe rules that supplement native Webflow styles.
